card.name: Verbs in suggestions and clarifying questions
card.fires_on: The verb or word right after a lead-in such as "do you", "if you are not sure" or "you may also", in web text that suggests an option or asks what someone means. It is often "mean", "try", "meant", "considering" or "interested".

modes.label: Clarifying meaning
modes.description: A verb of meaning in a question about what someone intended.

modes.label: Suggesting an option
modes.description: A verb that introduces a suggested next step or related item.
modes.example: Search for native plants by scientific name, common name or family. If you are not sure what you are looking for,<< try>> the Combination Search or our Recommended Species lists

modes.label: Other lead-ins
modes.description: Words in phrases like "you may also be interested" or "did you know".
